Chuck Conboy

America First candidate for United States Senator, Nebraska · Challenger

Senior account manager, ProSource Wholesale

Chuck Conboy, 73, of Papillion, is the America First Party of Nebraska's nominee for U.S. Senate. He is running for office for the first time. The party was formed by petition in 2026 and announced him as its Senate candidate on Sept. 1, 2026, after the Nebraska Supreme Court rejected the state Republican Party's challenge to the party's recognition.

Where Conboy stands

Tariffs and trade
Says he is "totally against agricultural tariffs." Argues they can push other countries to build competing markets, citing Brazilian soybeans as an example.
Iran
Opposes U.S. involvement in the conflict in Iran and argues the money should be spent at home. Says he is not an isolationist but puts America first.
Military intervention and war powers
Says the U.S. should intervene militarily only when there is a clear and urgent threat to national security or an overwhelming attack on allies, and that Congress must authorize any use of the military and its funding.
Border security and immigration
Lists removing "illegal aliens" among his core values.
Cost of living
Says he will advocate for lower- and middle-class Nebraskans. Lists making health care and child care more affordable as central priorities.
Beef prices and agriculture
Says he plans to work to change laws on agriculture and farming. He has not given specifics in the coverage found.
Education
Supports improving education for children, including making it free or lower-cost.
Abortion
Lists opposition to abortion among his core values.
Government overreach and religious freedom
Lists freedom of religion and halting government overreach among his core values.

Background

  • America First Party nominee for U.S. Senate, Nebraska (2026); first run for office
  • Former management at Baker's Supermarkets
  • Vice president, Union No. 271 (1980s)
  • Education: pre-med studies, Creighton University (no degree)
  • Hometown: Papillion, Nebraska; lifelong Nebraskan
